purpose: Frozen independent expectations for T4-U4b (DEL-04-07 Design arc-frames-and-signs.md section 9): arc stress quantities on realized arcs, with the straight members of the same lines, on both D-5 section bases (exact route) or the one preview section.
claim_fence: Standard claim fence applies (F-PIP-2; claims taxonomy per DEC-081).
request_sha256: none yet: model 0.6.0 requests are authored from cases.json when defined
generator: generators/u4b_reference.py (standard library; decimal at 90 significant digits)
value_format: every value is [decimal with 40 significant digits, binary64 nearest]; "0" is exact zero: either known exactly (a fibre coordinate formed from a vector component that is exactly zero) or an arithmetic residue of the 90-digit working precision below 1e-60 in SI units; the generator asserts that no written nonzero value is below 1e-30 and that every such residue shrinks below 1e-80 at 110 digits; vectors under derived.*.tangent_frames_global_components are informational decimals

conventions.tangent_frame: at arc angle psi from authored node i: x = arc tangent toward authored j; z = bend-plane normal (x_i - c) x (x_j - c), normalised; y = z x x, toward the arc centre (DEL-04-07 arc-frames-and-signs.md section 2). On a straight: x = chord, y = y_reference projected, z = x x y
conventions.cuts: j-side section action (the authored-j side acting on the authored-i side), N positive in tension. On pressurized members of the exact route S is the effective (elastic) axial force and N_w = S + p Ai the wall force; elsewhere N
conventions.stations: end_i, quarter_1, midspan, quarter_3, end_j at authored fractions 0, 1/4, 1/2, 3/4, 1 (psi = fraction * phi on an arc)
conventions.fibres: angle beta on the section from +y toward +z: y_pos 0 deg (intrados on an arc), diag_45, z_pos 90 deg (crown), diag_135, y_neg 180 deg (extrados), z_neg 270 deg (crown); surfaces outer (r_o) and inner (that basis's r_i); fibre coordinates (y, z) = r (cos beta, sin beta)
conventions.normal_stress: sigma_x(y, z) = N_eff/A_b + M_y z/I_b - M_z y/I_b (STRESS_REFERENCE section 1), N_eff = N_w on pressurized members of the exact route, otherwise N
conventions.normal_extremes: sigma_plus/minus = N_eff/A_b +/- hypot(M_y, M_z)/Z_b at the outer fibres (y, z) = +/- r_o (-M_z, M_y)/hypot; tied when the bending is zero; max_abs_normal = |N_eff|/A_b + hypot(M_y, M_z)/Z_b
conventions.shear_components: tau_xy, tau_xz are the traction components on the +x (j-side) face; Saint-Venant flexure (sv_transverse_shear) and torsion (torsional_shear = T r_o/J_b, signed with T) are separate quantities; flexure_plus_torsion_check adds the torsion field (-T z/J_b, T y/J_b) at the outer named fibres
conventions.section_bases: exact route (D-5): nominal_section (wall t) and reduced_section (t_r = (t - c_m) - c_a), each its own A, I, J = 2I, Z = I/r_o with r_o = D/2; the pressure bore r_i,r = D/2 - t_r with Ai = pi r_i,r^2 governs p Ai; preview route: preview_single_section (wall t - c_m)
conventions.directional_sif: on an arc M_z is in-plane and M_y out-of-plane at every section (U4a section 9); intensified_bending = hypot(i_ip M_z, i_op M_y)/Z_b
conventions.maximum_location: psi (rad from authored i) and fraction psi/phi on an arc; fraction u on a straight
conventions.fibre_coordinates: the compared quantities of a named fibre (sigma_plus_fibre, sigma_minus_fibre, governing_fibre, the sv_transverse_shear_max fibres) are its coordinates (y, z), at the criterion with zero scale r_o; they are formed from the defining vector, so a component that is exactly zero is written as an exact "0"
conventions.beta_deg: informational, never compared: a fibre's angle in (-180, 180], exactly 0, 90, 180 or -90 on an axis, so a fibre on the -y axis (z = 0, y < 0) is +180, never -180
conventions.sv_maximum_fibres: the two inner fibres of sv_transverse_shear_max (normal to V) are an unordered pair; the oracle lists them by ascending beta_deg and a consumer matches them as a set

bore_load_transferred_toroidal_membrane_.quantity: toroidal_membrane_hoop: the area average of the hoop stress over the wall cut at section angle beta, from exact equilibrium of the bore pressure transferred to that cut, the arc idealized as a complete torus in an axisymmetric membrane state (no transverse shear resultant on the cuts, no end or tangent-junction effects, reference geometry, small strain, internal p signed, external zero)
bore_load_transferred_toroidal_membrane_.closed_form: sigma_h(beta) = (p r_i,b / t_b) (2R - r_i,b cos beta) / (2R - (r_i,b + r_o) cos beta)
bore_load_transferred_toroidal_membrane_.bore: ruling (a): on each basis b the bore is that basis's own annulus bore r_i,b with wall t_b; the nominal basis uses r_i,n
bore_load_transferred_toroidal_membrane_.domain: R > r_o (the torus does not self-intersect); the expression stays finite for R > r_m
bore_load_transferred_toroidal_membrane_.properties: crown (cos beta = 0) = p r_i,b / t_b, the straight Lame wall mean; R -> infinity gives the same everywhere; thin wall gives the classical (p r/2t)(2R - r cos beta)/(R - r cos beta); for p > 0 intrados > crown > extrados (monotone in cos beta)
bore_load_transferred_toroidal_membrane_.radial_surface: -p at the basis's bore, 0 at the outer surface
bore_load_transferred_toroidal_membrane_.named_alternate_variant_b: pressure bore r_i,r loading the nominal wall: p r_i,r (2R - r_i,r cos beta) / (t_n (2R - (r_i,n + r_o) cos beta)); information and discriminator only (its crown differs from the straight nominal Lame mean)

local_straight_annulus_on_arc.quantity: sv_transverse_shear: the Saint-Venant flexure field of the homogeneous straight annulus of each basis (SHEAR_REFERENCE INDEPENDENT_REFUTATION section 2), driven by the tangent-frame V_y and V_z of each section by superposition, with no curvature correction; on straights the same field
local_straight_annulus_on_arc.field: C = 1/(2(1+nu) I_b), c = (3+2nu)/4; at (y, z) = r (cos beta, sin beta): tau_r = -C c (r^2 - r_o^2)(r^2 - r_i^2)/r^2 (V . e_r), tau_beta = C g(r) (V . e_beta), g(r) = c (r_o^2 + r_i^2 + r_o^2 r_i^2 / r^2) - (1-2nu) r^2 / 4
local_straight_annulus_on_arc.maximum: tau_max = |V| ((3+2nu) r_o^2 + (1+2nu) r_i^2) / (4 (1+nu) I_b), on the inner surface at the two fibres normal to V (beta = atan2(V_z, V_y) +/- 90 deg; an unordered pair), directed along V
local_straight_annulus_on_arc.domain: every isotropic -1 < nu < 1/2 with 0 < r_i < r_o (proof in the README: at r = r_i, B0 < 0 < B2; g = B2 - B0 decreases strictly in r and exceeds |B0 + B2| <= c (r_o - r_i)^2 elsewhere); the location is unique up to the two fibres
local_straight_annulus_on_arc.limits: thin wall: 2V/A; small hole: twice the solid-circle centre value (3+2nu)/(2(1+nu)) V/A; nu = 0: |V|(3 r_o^2 + r_i^2)/(4I)

definitions.member_maximum: pipe_elastic_normal_stress_maximum_v2 and the preview maximum: max over the whole member of |N_eff|/A_b + hypot(M_y, M_z)/Z_b, per member and basis; headline = maximum over members per basis
definitions.intensified_bending: hypot(i_ip M_z, i_op M_y)/Z_b on arcs, per station and basis, never combined with anything; axial_plus_intensified_bending = |N_eff|/A_b + intensified_bending is the explicitly declared measure of STRESS_REFERENCE I1
definitions.intensified_bending_maximum: the along-arc maximum of the pure intensified bending measure hypot(i_ip M_z, i_op M_y)/Z_b, per arc and basis; no along-arc maximum of axial_plus_intensified_bending is frozen

criterion.rule: |observed - expected| <= 1e-9 * max(|expected|, zero_scale), in both solver modes

zero_scales.force: per member: max |N or S|, |V_y|, |V_z| over its five cuts (N_w rows use it too); if zero, the case's largest, then the case's largest |N_w|
zero_scales.moment: per member: max |T|, |M_y|, |M_z| over its five cuts; if zero, the case's largest
zero_scales.normal_stress: per member and basis: max over its five stations of max_abs_normal (fibre_normal, normal_extremes, member_maximum, intensified rows); if zero, the case's largest for that basis
zero_scales.shear_stress: per member and basis: max over its five stations of sv max + |torsional_shear| (all shear rows); if zero, the normal_stress scale
zero_scales.pressure_stress: per arc and basis: max(|p|, |hoop| over the fibres) (hoop and radial rows)
zero_scales.headline: the case's largest station max_abs_normal for that basis

criterion.locations: an end maximum's location is exact; an interior maximum's psi or fraction is compared within its location_band, intersected with the member domain (the distance over which the value stays inside the criterion); fibre coordinates (y, z) are compared at the criterion with zero scale r_o; beta_deg is informational and not compared; the two sv_transverse_shear_max fibres are matched as an unordered pair
criterion.location_bands: an interior psi (arcs) or fraction (straights) is compared within its location_band; end maxima are exact and carry no band; an interior headline carries its member's location_band; the global f'' >= -K bound gives loss <= |s|*distance + K*distance^2/2 from a supporting slope s at the centre; 99% tolerance budget leaves serialization margin, checked explicitly
criterion.maxima: every member and intensified maximum is certified: a rigorous upper bound on the true maximum (from a second-derivative lower bound) lies within 1e-2 tolerance above the frozen value, which is attained at the frozen location; the dense-sampling bracket is a coarser consistency check
criterion.discriminators: each listed row lies at least 1e3 tolerances from its expected value, so an observation that passes the criterion is more than 1e-9 max(|obs|, |wrong|) from the wrong value
criterion.unit_transforms: values are SI; compare a product's MPa or mm after exact conversion

markers.gap: no vetted basis fixes which local moment axis is in-plane at a geometry-only bend or branch marker at a straight end; no marker row is frozen beyond this control

algebra_classes_informational.status: information only: a classification, not a physics reference (STRESS_REFERENCE section 5)
algebra_classes_informational.rule: signed linear quantities combine only as matching signed quantities (same frame, station, fibre and basis) under the same linear operator; maxima and intensified measures are recomputed from the combined signed resultants or enveloped, never added, subtracted or scaled

u4a.selection: every case whose only support is one full anchor (statically determinate free tip)

u4a.criterion: |mine - U4a| / max(|U4a|, U4a's member zero_scale (stresses: that scale over A, Z or J/ro)) < 1e-20; U4a prints 22 significant digits
u4a.note: U4a's arc loads are per unit arc length; this generator reproduces U4a only under that reading

objectivity.meaning: every frame-local resultant, station stress quantity and member maximum of the moved copy equals the original's within this fraction of one tolerance; the residue is the binary64 rounding of the moved inputs

twin_and_variant_b.meaning: ruling (a) makes the arc crown equal the straight nominal Lame wall mean p r_i,n / t_n on each basis; variant (b) (pressure bore r_i,r loading the nominal wall) breaks that equality

maxima.dense_sampling_bracket_role: a coarse consistency check of the analytic value against 4,097 samples and a rigorous Lipschitz bound; its width is far wider than the criterion, so it does not by itself certify the maximum
maxima.certification_meaning: for every member and intensified maximum, a rigorous upper bound from f'' >= -K (K from the closed-form second derivatives) lies within 1e-2 tolerance of the frozen value, and no sample exceeds it; so the sign-change search missed no higher peak
maxima.straight_interior_second_derivative_chec: the exact f'' in the fraction at each interior straight maximum (from the polynomial resultants), reported separately from the global lower-curvature bound that sets its location_band, against a central second difference of f with step 1e-20

precision_stability.meaning: every written 40-digit value of the cases is stable against 20 more working digits; an exact zero is exactly zero at both precisions; every residue written as zero (below 1e-60 in SI units at 90 digits) is below 1e-80 at 110 digits, so it shrinks with the working precision; no written nonzero value is below 1e-30
